full_prompt_en: A square vintage-color photograph shows a copper-haired woman in left-facing profile amid a field of small golden flowers. Her short waves catch a warm amber rim of light against a deep slate-blue sky. The pale face turns slightly upward; dark red lips and a black high-necked garment provide precise dark accents. Bright yellow blossoms gather at the lower edge and rise at both sides, with several stems near the lens dissolving into soft out-of-focus circles. The sharpest detail falls on the woman's face and curled hair, while the foreground flowers and distant sky remain gently diffused. The color has a distinctive early-process character: saturated yellows and reds coexist with a cool, slightly muted blue, and fine grain softens the whole surface. Light feels theatrical yet natural, sculpting the bridge of the nose and cheek while leaving the far side of the face in mild shadow. The composition separates the dark clothing from the golden flowers and places the profile against uncluttered sky. Some blossoms edge into her silhouette without hiding it. The result feels like a period fashion study caught outdoors, simultaneously crisp and dreamy. Its mood comes from the opposition of warm floral color, cool open background and a poised, inward-looking figure.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅正方形复古彩色照片呈现一位铜发女子在细小金色花丛中向左侧转脸。短卷发在深灰蓝天空前接住暖琥珀色边光。浅色面容略微上扬；深红嘴唇与黑色高领衣饰形成精确深色点。明黄花朵聚在下缘并从两侧升起，近镜头的几根茎化为柔软失焦圆斑。最清楚的细节落在脸和卷发上，前景花与远方天空则轻柔扩散。色彩具有早期彩色工艺的独特质感：饱和黄红与偏冷、略压低的蓝色共处，细颗粒柔化整个表面。光线既带戏剧性又显自然，塑造鼻梁和脸颊，使远侧面容落入温和阴影。构图将深色衣饰从金色花丛中分出，并把侧脸安放在干净的天空前。一些花朵贴入剪影边缘，却未将其遮住。结果像一幅在户外摄得的时代时装研究，同时清脆而梦幻。气氛来自暖花色、冷而开阔的背景与端静内省的人物之间的对照。
style_prompt_en: The style is vintage color photography with fine grain, selective focus and richly separated warm and cool hues. A sharply modeled central profile or form sits against a simple cool field, while near details dissolve into soft chromatic blur. Amber edge light and saturated yellow-red accents glow against muted slate blue and deep black. Gentle tonal softness recalls early color processes without erasing facial or surface detail. The square crop balances a poised focal silhouette with loose luminous foreground texture.
style_prompt_zh: 这种风格是具有细颗粒、选择性焦点和明确冷暖分离的复古彩色摄影。被清楚塑造的中央侧面形体置于简洁冷色场前，近处细节则溶成柔软的彩色虚影。琥珀边光与饱和黄红色重音在压低的石板蓝和深黑色前发亮。温和调子柔化唤起早期彩色工艺，却不抹去面部或表面细节。正方形裁切平衡端静的焦点剪影与松散发光的前景肌理。
theme_en: A copper-haired woman in profile among golden flowers
theme_zh: 金色花丛中的铜发侧面女子
name: Dufaycolor photograph
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
